recovery_lessons: configured push triggers are not proof of an exact-SHA successful run
exact-head PR CI and exact-main release evidence are distinct claims
Drive presence alone is not recovery proof
schema or registry evolution must update fail-closed validators and tests in lockstep
stale or conflicted continuity PRs should be closed unmerged and replayed from exact current main
canonical market-data semantic authority must be registry-bound; caller-supplied timeframe, category, endpoint or finality labels cannot grant downstream eligibility
self-hosted local-runner recovery must verify portable Python bootstrap and workspace import paths explicitly; local-runner repair is operational continuity evidence, not production release authority
bounded gap repair must rotate across deferred windows and exhaustive repair must not stop solely because one round recovered zero candles while deferred gaps remain
paid AI provider integration is not proof of budget safety unless reservation, concurrency, retry, ambiguous-timeout accounting and deterministic pre-egress enforcement fail closed
local provider/tool probes are continuity observations only and do not confer production authority
laptop power-off and internet outage remain distinct failure modes and must never be collapsed into one recovery state
continuity snapshots that become stale during validation must be closed unmerged and replayed from exact current main; green CI does not make stale memory authoritative

Project Memory validation must bind STATE.json to externally observed repository evidence; the direct commit that integrates an exact-base snapshot may inherit freshness only for that one integration hop when STATE.json changed in that commit, and any later main advance must fail closed
frozen Gate 3 pre-egress policy is an executable acceptance boundary: provider-bound messages must be deterministically classified, sanitized and allowlisted before reservation or network I/O
event-driven CI failure issues require lifecycle retirement when a PR head advances, a PR closes, or the exact SHA later passes; detection without garbage collection creates operational noise
